A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Ravan research work, with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and complete Appendices A.1–A.4. Their different pagination and formatting do not prevent reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original federated fine-tuning experiments on vision and language benchmarks, including ablations, computational heterogeneity experiments, and additional GLUE results in Appendix A.4.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, and appendix experiments.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same frozen-basis multi-head adaptation, trainable core matrices and scaling factors, initialization choices, head-selection strategies, and product aggregation.

E1.justification: Both evaluate CIFAR-100, SVHN, 20 Newsgroups, six-source MRQA, and the same GLUE tasks. The I.I.D., non-I.I.D., and computationally heterogeneous scenarios, including appendix coverage, are unchanged.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain Full-FT, FedIT, FedEx-LoRA, FFA-LoRA, and Fed-SB. Computational heterogeneity experiments retain HetLoRA and FlexLoRA; no comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Both retain 20/50-client settings, Dirichlet alpha 0.3, three participating clients per round, and 50 local iterations. Models, parameter budgets, metrics, and the experimental settings in Appendix A.3 also match.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same initialization, scaling-factor, head-count, and computational heterogeneity analyses. Appendix A.4 preserves the additional heterogeneity comparisons and convergence curves.

E5.justification: Section 4.2 states that results average three random seeds in both versions. No repeated-run information, uncertainty reporting, or significance testing is added or revised.

E6.justification: The numerical results in Tables 1–6 and 14 and the plotted findings match across versions. For example, Table 6 retains average GLUE accuracies of 83.90 for Ravan and 83.21 for Fed-SB; the appendix GLUE configurations also retain identical scores.

T1.justification: The rank-expressivity derivations, exact-aggregation identities, and mathematical method definitions remain unchanged, including Equations 1–14. No assumptions, propositions, or proofs are added or removed.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about parameter efficiency, higher-rank updates, exact aggregation, and robustness to data and computational heterogeneity, including the stated 2–8% accuracy improvement.

C2.justification: The explanations of initialization, head selection, and rank saturation are retained. Section 5 preserves the same limitations concerning equal head counts across layers and untested differential privacy; Appendix A.2 retains the qualification about lacking real-world deployment.

D1.justification: Appendix A.3 retains the same learning-rate tables, optimizer settings, adapter targets, hardware, software versions, and runtime estimates. Rank specifications and code/data access information are also unchanged.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 54 references and retain the same related-work discussion in Appendix A.1. Their positioning relative to existing federated PEFT methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 adds an author email and a more specific departmental affiliation and revises the author header. The substantive prose, terminology, section sequence, and appendix organization remain essentially identical.

P2.justification: v2 redesigns presentation throughout: an illustrated green title banner, different heading typography, bold caption labels, wider text blocks, and revised spacing and float placement. Figures and tables are resized or repositioned across the main text and appendices, while their scientific contents remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 substantially restyles the document but preserves the same scientific evidence, reasoning, limitations, and reproducibility information. The new title design and denser layout produce no meaningful net change in explanatory clarity or evidential quality.
